skills.evidence: Strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals — hash maps, trees, and complexity analysis, applied confidently under time pressure
Practical coding skills — pattern matching, interval problems, and writing code that performs well on large inputs
Working knowledge of operating systems (process scheduling, virtual memory, concurrency primitives)
core networking (REST APIs, timeouts, request lifecycle)
Ability to design at the system level — sketch a cloud-based storage or notification service and reason about scalability and fault tolerance
Understanding of object-oriented design and SOLID principles, and how to design software that's easy to extend
Software engineering maturity — clean code habits, a real testing strategy, and comfort talking about technical debt honestly
Participate in Agile ceremonies and design reviews with your team; hold a high bar in code review
Strong communication — able to describe a hard problem you solved and how you collaborate across teams
Exposure to cloud infrastructure (Azure or similar)
